history_summary.value: The Ameraucana was developed in the United States during the 1970s from Chilean Araucana stock, with the aim of keeping the unusual blue-egg gene while breeding out the parent breed's lethal tufted and rumpless traits. It was added to the American Poultry Association's Standard of Perfection in 1984 as a breed distinct from the Araucana.
